profile.name: Koushik Bhupathiraju
profile.title: Software Developer & AI Engineer
profile.summary: Passionate about building scalable web applications and intelligent systems. I specialize in creating seamless user experiences backed by robust architectures. Currently exploring the intersection of AI and web technologies to solve real-world problems.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description: Monitored and resolved transmission issues from SPQ to Informatica PowerCenter and Oracle SQL Developer, ensuring seamless data flow to ERPs like SAP, Novora, and Ariba. Queried and debugged job failures in Oracle SQL Developer, improving transmission reliability across daily and weekly batch jobs. Optimized and rewrote repetitive SQL queries, improving maintainability and performance. Handled duplicate and missing data issues by analyzing workflows and ERPs, improving data accuracy and consistency by 30%. Used tools like SOAP UI and Postman for backend data testing and validation. Performed bulk upload, merge, alter, and delete operations in Oracle based on business requirements. Built ingestion pipelines with Kafka and HDFS, storing data in Cassandra, MongoDB, and Hadoop. Performed analysis using Spark, Hive, Cassandra CQL, and PySpark in training phase with a real time case study.

experience.title: Software Development Intern
experience.description: Built a fundraiser web app using React.js, Node.js/Express, and MongoDB. Integrated Stripe for secure payment processing and used Google OAuth for seamless user authentication. Utilized JWT tokenization for secure user sessions and built RESTful APIs, tested with Postman. Leveraged Cloudinary for efficient media storage and management, ensuring optimized image handling.

experience.title: Graduate Assistant
experience.description: Advised international applicants on admissions, visa processes, and program selection across multiple regions. Automated updates to the visa issuance Excel sheet using Pandas and generated insights through charts. Reviewed academic transcripts and grading scales to assist accurate and timely international application decisions.

projects.name: KV Cache Compression
projects.description: Completed a thesis on energy benchmarking of KV cache compression for LLM inference on GPUs. Built a GPU power measurement pipeline using NVML to compute joules/token and tokens/joule. Benchmarked eviction, quantization, and hybrid KV cache methods against no-compression baselines. Evaluated energy–performance trade-offs across context lengths, batch sizes, and models. Analyzed the impact of compression ratio vs. compute overhead on energy efficiency. Produced reproducible benchmarks and practical guidelines for energy-efficient LLM deployment.

projects.name: Money-Management Mobile App
projects.description: Developed a cross-platform money management app using Expo for rapid prototyping and deployment. Built a native-like front end with ReactNative, ensuring a seamless user experience across platforms. Implemented efficient server-side logic with Node.js, handling asynchronous requests effectively. Deployed and managed backend services on AWS DynamoDB, ensuring security and scalability.

projects.name: Trivia Game
projects.description: A multiplayer trivia game built in Python using a client-server architecture. Players connect as clients and buzz in to answer questions, with UDP handling fast buzzer signals and TCP managing reliable question/answer communication. The server tracks scores and determines which player buzzed first. Questions are stored in JSON, making it easy to add or modify content. This project demonstrates networking concepts, concurrency, and real-time game mechanics.

projects.name: ASL Recognition
projects.description: Built a real-time ASL recognizer using MediaPipe and OpenCV for hand tracking and landmark detection. Trained a ResNet50 ASL model with grayscale inputs and green screen preprocessing for static sign detection. Developed an ASL classifier using VGG16 with grayscale images and softmax-based multi-class prediction.

projects.name: Journal
projects.description: A full-stack web application that generates goal-oriented learning plans by breaking user intents (e.g., learning DSA) into actionable steps using the OpenAI API. The frontend is built with React and Vite, while the backend uses TypeScript with CommonJS and MongoDB for persistent journal storage. Users can generate goals, follow structured steps, and save personal journals. The project demonstrates AI integration, RESTful design, and modern full-stack development practices.
